        i += 3

result = ""
for idx, ch in enumerate(x):
    if idx == 0 and ch == '.':
        result += "dot"
    elif idx == 0 and ch == '@':
        result += "at"
    elif idx == len(x) - 1 and ch == '@':
        result += "at"
    elif idx == len(x) - 1 and ch == '.':
        result += "dot"
    else:
        result += ch
print(result)
